item.rats.cheese.jei_desc: 用於馴服老鼠。反復在野老鼠附近的地面上扔起司以馴服。
item.rats.cheese_stick.jei_desc: 用於設置老鼠的存放和提取的容器以及老鼠家的坐標。單擊老鼠與其綁定，然後單擊方塊或容器（箱子，熔爐，機器等）設置與物品運輸相關的選項。
item.rats.rat_flute.jei_desc: 用來給全體老鼠下命令。警告：將導致附近所有被馴服的老鼠停止執行任務並遵循命令。按住Shift鍵右擊以更改命令。
item.rats.rat_upgrade_basic.jei_desc: 最基礎的老鼠升級。盡管它本身沒有效果，但它是高級升級所需的合成原料。
item.rats.rat_upgrade_chef.jei_desc: 廚師升級的老鼠會烤熟任何持有的物品。烤制完成後，他們會嘗試將其放入其下方的容器中，或者只是將其扔在地上。此升級還為老鼠解鎖了制作特殊美食所需的技能。
item.rats.rat_upgrade_archeologist.jei_d: 升級了考古學家的老鼠將研究他們持有的物品，嘗試從中發現鼠西洲的文物。一旦發現了文物，他們將嘗試將其放入其下方的容器中，或者只是將其扔在地上。
item.rats.rat_upgrade_whitelist.jei_desc: 老鼠只會拾取或持有此列表中的物品。請右擊升級打開，然後將要列入白名單的物品存放在其中。
item.rats.rat_upgrade_blacklist.jei_desc: 老鼠只會拾取或持有不在此列表中的物品。請右擊升級打開，然後將要列入黑名單的物品存放在其中。
block.rats.rat_trap.jei_desc: 將食物（尤其是起司）放入捕鼠器中以吸引野鼠。當野鼠死在陷阱裏時，需要將其重置。
block.rats.rat_cage.jei_desc: 當一只老鼠坐在您的頭上或肩膀上（潛行右擊一只老鼠）時，請對籠子右擊將老鼠存放在裏面。再次右擊以釋放老鼠。鼠籠互相連通，並且同一籠中的兩只異性老鼠都有機會繁殖。
block.rats.rat_crafting_table.jei_desc: 用來自動合成，老鼠工作臺的上方需要一只帶有老鼠升級：合成的老鼠才能工作。然後把要合成的物品放在第一個插槽，然後把材料放在下面。這個過程可以通過小鼠運輸和收集實現自動化。

advancement.rats.ratbow_essence.title: In Stunning Technicolor!

block.rats.rat_cheese_feeder.desc0: Stores cheese for rats; the visible cheese disappears when the feeder is empty

container.rats.rat_crafting_table.requir: Requires a rat with a crafting upgrade above the table to function
entity.rats.dutchrat.ratlantis: The Flying Dutchrat is unable to manifest in this world
entity.rats.neo_ratlantean.ratlantis: The vial had no effect on this beast here
entity.rats.rat.command.hunt.desc: When given a Mob Filter upgrade, the rat will kill all mobs it lists. The rat will also place their remains in a deposit container, if assigned one. Use the §6Cheese Staff§r to set a deposit inventory.
entity.rats.rat.dismount: Sneak and punch air to remove rats from shoulder
entity.rats.rat.griefing: NOTICE: this world has Mob Griefing turned off. Rats may not work as expected! Tamed rats will not be able to perform many tasks you would normally expect them to because of this.\nTo fix this, all you need to do is enable the mob griefing gamerule.\nThis message will not appear again.
entity.rats.rat_baron.ratlantis: The siren is unable to bring forth anyone from this world
entity.rats.ratlantean_automaton.ratlant: This machine cannot properly function in this world
item.rats.cheese_staff.mark_home: Set home point for rat to %s
item.rats.little_black_worm.desc: Right click onto coarse dirt to turn into a centipede
item.rats.plague_heal_chance: Has a %s percent chance to remove plague effect
item.rats.rat_sack.too_full: Rat Sack can't hold any more rats!
item.rats.rat_upgrade.energy_desc0: Rat will transfer energy instead of items
item.rats.rat_upgrade_bottler.desc: Rat will pick up water or honey from nearby blocks when holding glass bottles and is set to the 'Work' command
item.rats.rat_upgrade_breeder.desc: Rats will use any held food to breed animals when set to the 'Work' command
item.rats.rat_upgrade_gardener.desc: Rats will break nearby tall grass and flowers when set to the 'Work' command
item.rats.rat_upgrade_idol.desc1: Piglins will not target or attack this rat nor will they target you if the rat is sitting on you
item.rats.rat_upgrade_lumberjack.desc0: Rats will fell trees when set to the 'Work' command
item.rats.rat_upgrade_lumberjack.desc1: If a rat has the 'Replanter' upgrade, it will plant saplings back where the tree used to be
item.rats.rat_upgrade_mob_filter.desc0: Rats will only target mobs that are on this list
item.rats.rat_upgrade_mob_filter.desc1: Right click to open selection GUI
item.rats.rat_upgrade_mount.respawn_desc: Cooldown on mount respawning when slain
item.rats.rat_upgrade_pickpocket.desc0: Rats will randomly take one of a Villager's trade results when set to the 'Work' command.
item.rats.rat_upgrade_pickpocket.desc1: Pickpocketing will sometimes result in your reputation going down or Iron Golems targeting your rat
item.rats.rat_upgrade_remedy.desc: Rat is able to heal itself over time
item.rats.rat_upgrade_sculked.desc1: Rats will emit no vibrations when performing tasks and cannot be detected by Wardens
item.rats.rat_upgrade_shears.desc0: Rat will shear sheep, mooshrooms, etc. when set to 'Work' command
item.rats.rat_upgrade_shears.desc1: Rats will collect honeycomb from nearby bee nests and hives
item.rats.rat_upgrade_support.desc0: Rat will throw healing potions when your health is low
item.rats.rat_upgrade_support.desc1: Rat may occasionally throw other potion buffs if you have full health
item.rats.rat_upgrade_time_manipulator.d: Rat will greatly increase tick speed of any block in a 5x3x5 area around it
item.rats.rat_upgrade_worker: 老鼠升级：机械动力工人
item.rats.rat_upgrade_worker.desc0: Rat can operate marked Create machines when set to Work
item.rats.rat_upgrade_worker.desc1: Uses seats, depots, basins, deployers and hand-operated blocks
item.rats.rat_upgrade_worker.desc2: Requires the Create mod in the instance
item.rats.ratbow_essence.flag: Dyes rats to look like the %s pride flag
item.rats.staff.no_rat: Staff is not bound to any rat

block.rats.rat_house.bound_elsewhere: This rat is already bound to another rat house
block.rats.rat_house.withdraw: Picked up %s from the rat house
